headline: Discovery partially constrained by XRPL architecture; 0 Ethereum addresses verified, XRPL contract addresses not available via standard block explorer search

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Doppler Finance' returns DOPP token at 0xdb2b015fc020a866e303b1d4c0bf3e0a9930ef74 (Ethereum). XRPL has no traditional block explorer with name-tag search functionality.
Official website https://www.doppler.finance fetched; no deployed contracts documentation page found. The app requires JavaScript execution; deployed addresses not surfaced via static fetch.
No audit links provided in per-protocol context; no audit PDFs fetched.

GitHub repo girin-app/contracts identified and fetched. Repository contains hardhat.config.ts but deployment artifacts (deployments/ folder, broadcast/ folder) were not enumerated in the fetched repository listing.

Protocol spans two chains (Ripple and Ethereum). Ripple/XRPL does not support smart contracts natively and has no EVM block explorer equivalent. Ethereum search yielded DOPP token only, not protocol infrastructure contracts.
No factory contracts identified; not applicable given XRPL's account-ledger model.
No admin addresses discovered with sufficient on-chain evidence.
All entries in admin_addresses[] require on-chain evidence; none qualified for inclusion due to inability to verify deployed contracts.

rationale.verdict: Protocol operates primarily on XRPL, which is fundamentally non-EVM and lacks traditional smart contract model with discoverable addresses. The Ethereum presence appears limited to a governance/utility token (DOPP) and a RLUSD vault, but vault contract addresses were not surfaced. GitHub repository exists but deployment artifacts were not accessible within tool constraints. XRPL infrastructure cannot be verified via standard block-explorer enumeration. No deployed contract addresses could be reliably attributed to this protocol with on-chain evidence.

evidence.shows: Protocol marketing/dashboard site; identifies Doppler Finance as XRPfi yield infrastructure for XRP holders; requires JavaScript to render deployed addresses.
DOPP token contract on Ethereum; associated with Doppler but unclear if this is governance, utility, or other role.
Repository for Doppler/Girin smart contracts; uses hardhat deployment framework; Solidity codebase; 6 commits at time of fetch; no public releases.
Girin Labs GitHub organization listing 15 repositories; contracts repository identified; other repos are utility libraries (wallet integrations, XRPL/TRN libraries).
Girin Wallet blog; confirms Doppler Finance as first XRPfi project on XRP Ledger; describes CeDeFi-based yield integration rather than smart contracts.
Protocol description; mentions Doppler Vaults for XRP/RLUSD deposits, 7-day withdrawal period; Ethereum RLUSD vault noted but no contract address provided.

unknowns: D1-offchain: XRPL does not provide block-explorer name-tag search; addresses on XRPL (if any) cannot be enumerated via standard explorer interface.
D2-offchain: app.doppler.finance requires JavaScript rendering; static deployed-contracts documentation page not found at standard paths (/docs/deployments, /docs/addresses, etc.).
D3: No audit links provided in protocol context; unable to extract contract addresses from audit reports.
D4: girin-app/contracts repository fetched but deployment artifacts (hardhat-deploy directory, broadcast logs, manual address indices) not enumerated; commit SHA not pinned (main branch only).
D5: Ripple chain cannot be verified on-chain via standard block explorer; XRPL infrastructure likely custodial or off-chain rather than smart contract-based.
D6-ethereum: RLUSD vault mentioned in documentation but vault contract address on Ethereum not surfaced; factory enumeration not attempted due to address gap.
D8: Zero addresses recovered from D1–D5 with sufficient on-chain evidence (block-explorer verification or GitHub artifact pinning).

protocol_metadata.about: Doppler Finance is a CeDeFi protocol providing institutional-grade yield infrastructure for XRP holders through the XRPfi model. The protocol combines CeFi strategies with on-chain yield mechanisms across the XRPL and Ethereum, enabling deposits (up to 10M XRP per batch) to generate 3–4.5% APY while accumulating Doppler Points for future airdrops.
